description: CEO announces medical leave of absence until end of June 2009; COO to run day-to-day operations

notes: Fortune and CNNMoney report the release came after the regular session and shares fell in after-hours trading

announcement_time_et: market holiday (Martin Luther King Jr. Day)
primary_source: SEC 8-K (Item 5.02) accepted 2011-01-18 06:19 ET; media advisory dated 2011-01-17 (acc. 0001181431-11-003847)
confounding: Q1 FY2011 earnings 8-K accepted 2011-01-18 16:30 ET: affects day +1
notes: Day 0 is clean of the earnings release; windows that include day +1 are not

description: CEO resigns; COO named CEO; former CEO elected chairman
notes: News reports give an after-hours fall of about 5%

description: Board announces the death of its chairman and former CEO
primary_source: Apple board statement 2011-10-05; SEC 8-K (Item 8.01) accepted 2011-10-06 06:29 ET (acc. 0001181431-11-051976)
confounding: Apple product event on 2011-10-04 (day -2; date from memory and not checked against a source)
notes: Not a change in the CEO role: he had resigned as CEO on 2011-08-24; the AP report gives an after-hours fall on 2011-10-05

description: CEO announces retirement within 12 months; board committee to choose successor
notes: Premarket trading after the news is reported by Entrepreneur and BGR; a positive reaction

description: Board names a new CEO; founder leaves the chair to become technology adviser
primary_source: Microsoft press release 2014-02-04; SEC 8-K (Items 5.02/9.01) accepted 2014-02-04 17:11 ET (acc. 0001193125-14-035080)
notes: Outcome of the search announced on 2013-08-23; Al Jazeera reports premarket trading after the news; possible anticipation by earlier media reports not checked

description: Co-founders step down as Alphabet CEO and President; Google CEO becomes Alphabet CEO; founders keep board seats and voting control
notes: Reuters and Fortune report a small after-hours move after the announcement

description: CEO announces divorce on social media
primary_source: News reports of the CEO's post (no company filing)
notes: Exact minute of the post not established; reports describe a Wednesday-morning post and an intraday dip; day 0 is 2019-01-09 whether it came just before or after the open

description: Divorce settlement terms: about 4% of shares to the former spouse; CEO keeps sole voting control of them
notes: Social-media posts on the settlement may have preceded the 8-K on the same day

description: CEO to become executive chair in Q3 2021; AWS CEO to succeed him
confounding: Announced in the Q4 2020 earnings release (same 8-K)
notes: The CEO news cannot be separated from the earnings news with daily data

description: CEO posts that he is considering taking Tesla private at $420, "funding secured"
primary_source: SEC complaint SEC v. Musk 1:18-cv-08865 (S.D.N.Y. 2018-09-27) paras 2 and 33; trading halted 14:08-15:45 EDT (paras 40 and 46)
notes: A statement by the CEO about a corporate transaction later found by the SEC complaint to be misleading; a positive day-0 reaction

description: Blog post attributed to the CEO announces that the going-private effort is abandoned
primary_source: SEC complaint SEC v. Musk (2018-09-27) para 58
notes: The complaint (para 60) gives the close on 2018-08-27

description: SEC sues the CEO for securities fraud and seeks an officer-and-director bar
confounding: Settlement announced Saturday 2018-09-29 (affects day +1); see TSLA-2018-09-29
notes: Reports give an after-hours fall on 2018-09-27; day 0 is clean but windows including day +1 contain the settlement

description: CEO and Tesla settle with the SEC; CEO to step down as chairman for three years; $20m penalty each
confounding: Tesla 8-K with preliminary Q3 information and a CEO email accepted 2018-10-01 06:14 ET (day 0); further 8-K (Items 2.02/7.01) accepted 2018-10-02 08:35 ET (day +1); complaint on day -1

description: CEO posts that Tesla's stock price is "too high"
confounding: Q1 2020 earnings 8-K accepted 2020-04-29 16:56 ET: reaction on 2020-04-30 (day -1)
notes: Day 0 is clean; windows that include day -1 contain the earnings reaction

description: Twitter's board agrees to be acquired by Tesla's CEO for about $44bn
primary_source: Twitter 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) accepted 2022-04-25 16:44 ET (acc. 0001193125-22-117720) and press release of the same day
notes: Twitter shares were halted in the afternoon pending the news; most of any Tesla reaction falls on day +1

description: Public dispute between the CEO and the US President on social media
confounding: The dispute included statements about federal contracts and EV tax credits: a policy channel as well as a key-person one

primary_source: SEC 8-K (Items 5.02/9.01) accepted 2026-11-12 08:52 ET with press release (acc. 0001045810-26-000082)
